description: Metasequoia IME, an open-source Chinese IME for Windows 10/11 built on TSF, supporting full pinyin / double pinyin / Wubi, auxiliary codes, and AI-powered suggestions
notes: Install and uninstall pop a UAC elevation prompt (the official Inno Setup installer requires admin privileges).
Requires Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) 14.40 or later (install nonportable/vcredist2022); without it the IME process silently crashes on startup.

The program installs to Program Files\metasequoiaime and the TSF DLL to System32\IME\MetasequoiaIME (hard requirements for uiAccess and game Trusted Mode); dictionaries, config, and skin data persist in persist\msime\data.
After install, switch to 'Metasequoia IME' with Win+Space; settings are reachable from the Start Menu entry 'Metasequoia IME'.
scoop uninstall removes the data directory along with the official uninstaller; back up persist\msime\data first if you want to keep it.

script: Write-Host 'Running MetasequoiaIME installer (confirm the UAC prompt)...' -f Cyan
if (-not $gone) { Write-Host "Could not delete installer '$fname' (locked by antivirus?); it will be removed with this version directory on cleanup." -f Yellow }
Write-Host 'Running MetasequoiaIME uninstaller (confirm the UAC prompt)...' -f Cyan
Write-Host 'Official uninstaller not found (already uninstalled?), skipping.'
